text: Pane: A toggle adds cognitive load for users who just want one mode to work—most won’t discover it until they’re frustrated. Instead, detect ambient light and auto-switch; test glare-readability with 10 screencast users under both conditions. The real risk isn’t speed—it’s users abandoning the tool when they can’t read it fast.
